sources.title: CostaLab Bad Angel | Effects Database
sources.excerpt: Published on July 7, 2016 CostaLab distortion overdrive pedal Information CostaLab The CostaLab Bad Angel is a pedal with a double nature. An open overdrive, clear and dynamic and even a powerful distortion achieving high saturation levels, with high definition and a very focused timbre. Simply by adjusting the Drive pot, you can get from a soft crunch to a hard rock sound and even more. The button "Saint Sinner" engages one of two different clipping circuits, developed in years of works and tests. They originate two very different characters. One is more classic and compressed, the other more modern and dynamic. The tone pot gives the guitarist the chance to optimize its sound sweeping in an accurate range, totally usable, without getting solutions theoretically possible but not realistic.
